Privacy

This notice explains how Rucking Revolution handles information when you use the website or contact us.

Website use

The website provides publicly accessible training resources and assessment information. It does not require an account. The site itself does not use analytics or advertising scripts. Search, filters and comparison choices can appear in the page address.

Technical information

Hosting providers may process technical information such as IP addresses, request times and requested pages to deliver the website, maintain security and diagnose problems. Avoid putting personal information in search fields or shared links.

When you contact us

If you email us, we use the information you provide to respond to your request and manage relevant correspondence. Email and hosting providers may process information as part of delivering their services.

Retention and your choices

We aim to keep correspondence only as long as needed for the purpose of the contact and any applicable legal obligations. You may ask about access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability or objection where those rights apply.

External websites

Official assessment publishers, event organisers and social platforms operate their own websites and privacy policies.

Contact and complaints

Contact Rucking Revolution at info@ruckingrevolution.org for privacy questions or requests. You may also contact the Norwegian Data Protection Authority (Datatilsynet) or your applicable supervisory authority.
